result.description:
Supagas is a leading supplier of LPG, industrial, medical, specialty and helium gases in Australia. They are a fast-growing nation-wide company and are rapidly building a reputation for growth and success based on an exceptional ‘YES WE CAN’ customer service offering and quality product in the highly competitive market.

They are seeking experienced Bulk Delivery Drivers to join their team. Location: Australia-wide.

The Role:
The primary purpose of this role is to promote and Foster the “Yes We Can” attitude with both internal and external customers and representing Supagas in a positive and professional manner, to comply with all safety and regulatory requirements regarding the Transport of Dangerous Goods, securing a load, and other road rules relevant to the vehicle being driven.

Task List:
Follow correct procedures and be an example to fellow workers
Check daily that vehicle is roadworthy, equipped with all necessary safety equipment and is clean.
Make sure the truck is serviced as per the manufacturer’s requirements and Supagas procedures.
Make sure that the tanker is filled with sufficient amounts of LPG to cover all daily deliveries
Make sure all daily documentation, including but not limited to all delivery docket and manifests, is completed fully and correctly, all counts completed and checked, and all paperwork, cheques and cash handed in every day.
Deliver all orders and milk runs on the allocated daily run
Communicate all issues and non-deliveries immediately to the Logistics team
Respect all customer’s property and requirements.
Assist the company to educate our customers and make sure all customers handle and store gas appropriately and safely.
Carry out any housekeeping to maintain a safe workplace on and off the road.
Immediately report any factors which create an unsafe site for bulk deliveries to the Logistics Manager for follow up and also prior to delivery if known.
Assist the company to make sure maximum utilisation of company assets and protection of those assets.
Before every fill check test dates of cylinders and report out of date cylinders to the Logistics team.
Check Compliance Plates for all fixed Installations prior to refill and report non-compliant sites to the Logistics team.
Support the sales team and build the area by referring potential customers.
Make sure personal compliance with regulations regarding Dangerous Goods Licences.
Make sure you have the correct and adequate drivers licence for bulk delivery transportation.
Immediate reporting of any vehicle or property damage (no matter how small or large) to Logistics Manager.
Other general duties as assigned and required.
Promoting the benefits of Supagas & Supagas products
Work in a team environment and work together to maximise the productivity of the team.
Maintain safety, tidiness and housekeeping throughout entire office.
Report any hazards or problems immediately to your Supervisor at all times.

If you wish to apply for this position please submit updated resume
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
